title: Query an OData v4 entity set through the contract Dataset
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that queries the OData v4 service rooted at <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>/odata/TripPin, entity set "People". Use the contract API from @honua/sdk-js: HonuaClient with { baseUrl: <base URL> }, createDataset from @honua/sdk-js/contract with one source { id: "people", protocol: "odata", locator: { url: <base URL>/odata/TripPin, entitySet: "People" }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES.odata } and skipCompatibilityCheck: true. Query with { pagination: { limit: 2 } }. The Result exposes features (attributes are the entity properties) and totalCount (from @odata.count). Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <result.features.length>, "firstUser": <UserName attribute of the first feature>, "totalCount": <result.totalCount>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: OData $filter/$top mapping behind the same typed Query.
